author: VanZandtVS
body:
The best idea I've seen for something like this is a buildable "market board" type thing for your town.  Build it and all the shops / bestiaries in your town are represented in one screen with tabs to cycle between bestiaries / shops / herbalists etc, maybe with a "buy all" option with checkboxes for different items so you can do a mass purchase for converting junk into resources.

We all get tired of clicking through 50 shops in our own personal CostCo setups.  This'd be a big quality of life change.

author: scsibusfault
body: I just got rid of all but 10 shops or so. I got tired of checking 30+ and buying everything. I get enough stuff from 10 shops, and if I'm really bored, I can pay to restock and roll the dice again. Looks better, takes up less space, and less time wasted.

author: gruey
body: My idea was just to have stores have a two dimension leveling system.   They could have the current quality and a new quantity.  Raisins a quantity to 3x just rolls 3 shop inventories and combines them, either adding the new item or increasing quantity.  Cost to level shops would be the current price times the multiplier so it works and costs exactly like building two shops.
